# fjordrun_project (Resource)

A project: services and the environments they run in. A new project has one environment, `production`, exposed as `default_environment_id`; add others with `fjordrun_environment`.

~> Deleting a project deletes all its environments, services, volumes and their data. Needs the admin role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id     = var.team_id
  name        = "shop"
  description = "The online shop"
  region      = "nbg1"
}

output "production_environment_id" {
  value = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name (1-100 characters).
- `team_id` (String) The team that owns the project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text (up to 2000 characters).
- `icon` (String) Icon name (up to 50 characters).
- `region` (String) Where services run: `nbg1` (Nuremberg, the default), `fsn1` (Falkenstein) or `hel1` (Finland). The API refuses a new project in a location that isn't open yet. Volumes stay in their location: the API refuses a change while the project has volumes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `default_environment_id` (String) The environment API calls use when they name none: `production`, or the oldest environment if it was deleted.
- `id` (String) Project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by project ID
terraform import fjordrun_project.shop 55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555
```
